Import a text file to create an EZ-InSAR insitu data file

The function will create an EZ-InSAR insitu data file from a .txt file

Parameters
file:str.txt file
delimiter:strdelimiter symbol [Default: ';']
header:intNumber of header lines [Default: 0]
colnames:listList of str for row names [Default: ['date','displacement']]
dataunits:listList of str for units [Default: ['time','mm']]
